'''Ottaviano Menni''' was an Italian mathematician and [[mestre de camp]] who lived between the 17th and 18th centuries.<ref>{{cite book|title=Gli scrittori italiani che dettarono sulle fortificazioni dall'origine al tempi presenti|publisher=G. Cassone e comp.|date=1866|page=76|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gks6AAAAMAAJ&pg=PA76|language=it}}</ref>
